turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes. Who decided to put a zero in the gradebook before anyone called me?
"Get this over with." Okay, then answer my question: who entered that zero, and did anyone hear Owen first?
Look, your son cheated. Everyone knows it. I'm not wasting my evening on this.
"Everyone knows." Then you'll have it in writing, so show me. Until you do, my son didn't cheat, and you just made my next stop the principal's office.
You lawyers think you can bully anyone.
I asked for a document, Hale, and you've given me an insult. I'm writing that down. Do you have anything with a date on it, yes or no?
Are you going to keep wasting my time?
"Wasting your time." You entered a zero before you called me, and Owen found out from his phone in front of his class. Withdraw it, or I'm in the principal's office at 4:40 instead of on my call.
